purpose: One shared fail-closed financial truth record for Revenue, Cash, AP and later financial metrics.
rules: Control Tower is a projection; this contract is the shared canonical financial truth shape.
ACTUAL and ESTIMATE may expose a numeric value only when the value is finite and period, scope, source, as_of, reconciliation_status and lineage are explicit and valid.
GAP and NOT_CONNECTED always expose value=null even if an upstream source supplies a number.
Missing numeric values never normalize to zero. Explicit zero is valid only when a trusted ACTUAL or ESTIMATE record proves zero under the same metadata rules.
Unknown branch or channel remains null. ALL is accepted only when aggregate_proven=true.
ACTUAL is true only for the exact period, scope and lineage represented by the record.
Negative finite values are generically allowed because some financial metrics can be negative; metric policy may forbid them.
Metric policy may require specific reconciliation states, for example RECONCILED Revenue.
Source, evidence, lineage, message and reason must be privacy-safe labels only: no Drive IDs, Drive URLs, raw private records or secrets.
Normalization is pure, deterministic and idempotent; it creates no write path, ledger, RPC, migration, integration or UI.
